name: OwnTV music sources
description: The lossless (FLAC / Tidal) servers Music -> Sources starts from. A device reads this list with Music -> Sources -> Update list; it changes the addresses and statuses of the entries the app already has and adds the ones it does not (a source the person removed is not added back).

sources.name: Tidal HiFi (thevolecitor)
sources.notes: Tidal hifi-api v2.10, no login; FLAC 16/44.1 and Hi-Res as DASH. Third-party, can stop at any time.

sources.name: All In Eclipse (phantomic12)
sources.notes: Speaks the Eclipse proxy protocol, but only had 128 kbps MP3 to give on 2026-10-04 (refused by the FLAC step).

sources.name: Eclipse proxy (PlayTorrio)
sources.follows: PlayTorrio lib/services/music/qobuz_music_service.dart (defaultEndpoint, generateUrl); check with tools/fork/check_playtorrio_flac.py in OwnTV core
sources.notes: The worker PlayTorrio v1.1.6 ships; Cloudflare answers error 1042 (its account is gone) since 2026-10-04.
